item.title: Boot Barn location coming to Clarksburg
item.description: The store sells a variety of western-style clothes, such as cowboy and hiking boots, hats, belt buckles, jeans, jewerly and more.

item.title: West Virginia Secretary of State Kris Warner thanks helpers after Pendleton County crash
item.description: Warner went on to say that he was still able to make it to present the Centurion Awards to the three businesses that have operated continuously for 100 years in Pendleton County.

item.title: Former Wheeling Nailers assistant coach is now head coach of U.S. Women’s National Ice Hockey team
item.description: John Wroblewski, who was an assistant coach with the Wheeling Nailers during the 2010–11 season, is now the head coach of the United States Women’s National Ice Hockey Team.

item.title: Remembering Derek Hotsinpiller 15 years after his death through The Hotsinpiller Memorial Foundation
item.description: In 2001 Lt. James "Jim" W. Hotsinpiller, a member of the Bridgeport Police Department, passed suddenly, leaving behind his wife Pam and two sons, Dustin and Derek, who followed in their father's footsteps by becoming law enforcement officers.

item.title: Garrett College helps students elevate learning through ice climbing
item.description: This particular ice climbing class was open to the general public and saw participants come from as far as Pittsburgh to get in on the action. For most of the group, this was their first experience with ice climbing.

item.title: State legislature considers bill to increase penalties for assaults on athletes
item.description: House Bill 4999 also includes language to clarify that hard fouls “within the scope of the rules or nature of the sport” are exempt from this bill.

item.title: State Legislature advances bill banning lab-grown meat
item.description: The FDA approved the first lab-grown meat product in 2023. According to a report from the Good Food Institute in 2024, $3.1 billion has been invested in the lab-grown meat industry.

item.title: 1 transported to UHC after house fire in Salem
item.description: Information is limited at this time, however the Harrison County 911 center did confirm to 12 News that one person was transported from the scene by ambulance to UHC.

item.title: Purple Alert for 'mentally challenged' Morgantown man canceled
item.description: According to a press release from WVSP, 26-year-old Cody Harris was last seen at his home on Marie Lane in Morgantown on Feb. 16 at 6 a.m.

item.title: Medical examiner called to I-79 wreck, south lanes reopen
item.description: Marion County Rescue Squad officials said on Facebook that the interstate is expected to be closed for an extended time and are asking drivers to avoid the area.
